definition: שָׁרוֺן proper name, of a location Sharon (plausibly connected with √ ישׁר by Thes Ges 12 and others, compare GASm Geogr. 52 ; = * יְשָׁרוֺן ; Phoenician שרן ) — strictly noun masculine Isa 65:10 plain, level; — 1. ׳ הַשּׁ (with article), name of maritime plain on Mediterranean, from Joppa northward, noted for fertility, Isa 33:9 (|| בָּשָׁן , כַּרְמֶל ; ᵐ5 ὁ Σαρων ), compare הֲדַר כַּרְמֶל וְהַשָּׁרוֺן Isa 35:2 ; Isa 65:10 (|| עֵמֶק עָכוֺר ; ᵐ5 τῷ δρυμῷ ); ׳ חֲבַצֶּלֶת הַשּׁ Song 2:1 ( ᵐ5 ἄνθος τοῦ πεδίου ); ׳ הַבָּקָר הָרֹעִים בַּשּׁ 1Chr 27:29 so also Josh 12:18 where read ׳ מֶלֶךְ אֲפֵק לַשּׁ , so Di We Sam 55 Ges 12 after ᵐ5 , compare RS OTJC 2, 273, 435. — On this plain see GASm Geogr. 147 ff. שָׁרוֺן proper name, of a location Sharon (plausibly connected with √ ישׁר by Thes Ges12 and others, compare GASmGeogr. 52; = *יְשָׁרוֺן; Phoenician שרן) — strictly noun masculineIsa 65:10 plain, level; —

1. ׳הַשּׁ (with article), name of maritime plain on Mediterranean, from Joppa northward, noted for fertility, Isa 33:9 (|| בָּשָׁן, כַּרְמֶל; ᵐ5 ὁ Σαρων), compare הֲדַר כַּרְמֶל וְהַשָּׁרוֺן Isa 35:2; Isa 65:10 (|| עֵמֶק עָכוֺר; ᵐ5 τῷ δρυμῷ); ׳חֲבַצֶּלֶת הַשּׁ Song 2:1 (ᵐ5 ἄνθος τοῦ πεδίου); ׳הַבָּקָר הָרֹעִים בַּשּׁ 1Chr 27:29 so also Josh 12:18 where read ׳מֶלֶךְ אֲפֵק לַשּׁ, so Di WeSam 55 Ges12 after ᵐ5, compare RSOTJC 2, 273, 435. — On this plain see GASmGeogr. 147 ff. BuhlGeogr. § 65.
2. מִגְרְשֵׁי שָׁרוֺן, region east of Jordan 1Chr 5:16 (|| גִּלְעָד, בָּשָׁן; ᵐ5 τὰ περίχωρα Γεριαμ, ᵐ5 A Σαρων); identified by many with הַמִּישׁוֺר (Deut 3:10 etc., see above)
